deep_dive.title: Networked Humanoid Intelligence: Communication, Coordination, Collaboration, and Social Interaction
deep_dive.abstract: Humanoid robots are moving from laboratory platforms toward connected fleets that share workspaces, infrastructure, tasks, and knowledge with other robots and humans. As deployments grow, the operation and improvement of each humanoid depend on information exchanged across the network. However, existing research has largely studied humanoids as individual systems. This survey examines networked humanoid intelligence through four functions of information exchange: communication, coordination, collaboration, and social intelligence with human interaction. We first establish the foundations of networked humanoid systems, define the question addressed by each function, and connect them through a common factory scenario. We review the literature along six dimensions: interaction architecture, exchanged information, physical coupling, operating timescale, system scale, and embodiment. We separate results obtained with physical and simulated humanoids from those based on other robotic platforms or disembodied agents, because the latter do not fully capture humanoid-specific constraints such as balance, whole-body motion, contact, and physical interaction. We examine hardware, datasets, and benchmarks, and distinguish risks handled locally from those networking introduces, such as stale information or unsafe knowledge propagation. Finally, we identify open problems in control-aware networking, compact body-centric messages, physically grounded coordination, network- and embodiment-aware knowledge sharing, fleet-level social consistency, and accountable human oversight.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对人形机器人研究多聚焦单体、缺乏机群级信息交换综述的问题，本文以通信、协调、协作与人机社会交互四个功能构建网络化人形智能框架，并用工厂场景串联各功能。文章梳理了网络化系统基础、各功能核心问题与代表性方法，为多机器人协调与协作系统提供了统一参考。该综述还讨论了各功能之间的关联，并指出未来机群部署中的开放挑战。

quick_skim.title: Belief-Driven Search in Connectivity-Constrained Mobile Sensor Networks with Convergence Guarantees
quick_skim.abstract: Multi-agent search and coverage is critical to autonomous exploration, search-and-rescue, and defense applications. This paper investigates settings where a mobile sensor network is tasked with coordinating to discover the position of a stationary target within a bounded region. We develop a Bayesian update scheme where agents iteratively combine local uncertainties derived from their sensor measurements through inverse variance weighting to get a better global understanding of where the target may be located given some prior belief. Network agents' trajectories are governed by a primal-dual gradient update rule that simultaneously minimizes the expected sensing uncertainty and enforces network connectivity among the agents. We prove that the belief converges to the target under mild, planner-agnostic conditions, with an explicit exponential rate of false-hypothesis rejection and a bound on expected search time. Simulation results show that we can successfully find the target and collapse belief to the ground truth target location while ensuring connectivity of our sensor network. They also empirically confirm our theoretical bounds and revisiting assumption. Finally, we compare against a lawnmower sweep, showing that our method locates the target more quickly when the prior is informative.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Addresses multi-agent target search in connectivity-constrained mobile sensor networks by fusing local measurements with inverse-variance Bayesian belief updates and a primal-dual gradient controller that keeps links intact.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对移动传感器网络中多智能体协同搜索静止目标的问题，本文提出基于贝叶斯信念更新的协调框架，各智能体按逆方差加权融合局部测量以形成全局位置估计。智能体轨迹由原始-对偶梯度规则驱动，在最小化期望感知不确定性的同时保持网络连通性，并给出收敛性保证。该工作为受限通信条件下的多机器人协同搜索提供了可证明有效的方法。
